Linux Specialist (Hybrid-role) - Den Haag 
Our client is currently undergoing a large scale internal digital transformation to decentralize their infrastructure capabilities. Your biggest challenge will be to transform the infrastructure into a shared platform for all internal teams while maintaining 100% operational continuity for millions of end users. 
I am looking for someone who: - Has extensive hands-on experience with Docker Swarm and setting up container environments. - Possesses in-depth knowledge of CentOS 6/7 or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 6/7. - Has experience with configuration management tools such as Puppet and Ansible. - Is skilled in Linux scripting using Bash and/or Python. - Has experience with the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) for monitoring and logging. - Understands core infrastructure concepts such as DNS, SMTP/email, NTP, IP routing, and firewalls. - Has a good command of Dutch and/or English, both written and spoken. - Is willing to participate in a rotating 24/7 on-call schedule to ensure continuity. 
Someone interested in: - Designing, building, and maintaining an internal IaaS platform to support developers and business teams within the organization. - Ensuring a stable, secure, and high-performing Linux environment. - Documenting and auditing systems to maintain high quality and security standards. - Collaborating closely with internal technical teams to help them adopt containerized workflows. - Proactively resolving and preventing incidents before they impact the business. 
OpenShift experience will be a bonus, and we do need you to be part of a 24/7 on-call rota. 
Darwin Recruitment is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.
